name: Step 2: Your free focus
paint: A single glove with a small round core on its back, a tick in a ring above.
avoid: a real brand · a magic wand
prompt: Create one small fantasy-game UI SIGN in pure white #FFFFFF flat ink on a fully TRANSPARENT background. Subject ONLY: one empty practical focus glove upright, with five short stubby glove fingers and a single round mana-core fitting on the BACK of the glove. Above it, one small checkmark inside one simple ring. A compact, bold, slightly hand-inked silhouette with only two or three clear transparent interior separations, readable at 24px and 48px on charcoal #10151F. No living hand, skin, person, robot, mascot, face, wand, letters, numbers, brand, star, extra decoration or border. No shading, gray, black paint, glow, shadow, gradient, texture or blur. Only solid white forms and real transparent negative space. Full subject centered with a generous 15% clear margin, square 1024x1024 composition. The ring/check belongs to this camp-step sign, not to a mascot.
generation_reference_mode: Text-only new object-sign render; no reference-image inputs attached while the runtime was unavailable.
export_processing: Aspect-preserving alpha-bounds framing, Lanczos downsample/UI exports; white RGB enforced preserving generated alpha for ink modes
visual_review: Viewed on charcoal at full preview and actual 24/48px; unapproved review candidate.
